gloss: art room; art studio (in a school)

definitions.gloss: art room; art studio; art classroom
definitions.explanation: A room in a school designated for art classes, equipped with easels, supplies, and sinks for painting and other art activities.

examples.english: To paint in the art room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧、{美術室|びじゅつしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: After school, I finished my artwork in the art room.

examples.japanese: {美術室|びじゅつしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{石膏像|せっこうぞう}やイーゼル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Plaster busts and easels were lined up in the art room.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ (art, fine arts) and ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). A standard fixture in Japanese schools, where ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ is a required subject in junior high school.
